test_title: PYST 13: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 13 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following belongs to the Lakshadweep group of islands?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kannur Islands**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kannur Islands** belong to the **Lakshadweep group of islands**, which are a group of 36 small islands located in the **Arabian Sea**, off the southwestern coast of India.
 
• The Lakshadweep islands are the smallest Union Territory of India and are known for their **pristine beaches, coral reefs, and biodiversity.**
 
• The name Lakshadweep translates to "**one hundred thousand islands**" in Sanskrit, symbolizing the many small islands that form this region. *Hence, option 1 is correct.*
 
• Other islands mentioned in the options, such as **Kamorta Island** and **Chowra Island**, belong to the **Andaman and Nicobar Islands**, which are located in the Bay of Bengal and do not form part of the Lakshadweep group.
 
• **Milo Island** is not a recognized island in India and does not belong to any Indian island group. *Hence, options 2, 3, and 4 are incorrect.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Lakshadweep Islands:**

 
 
• **Location:** The Lakshadweep islands are located approximately 200–440 km off the southwestern coast of **Kerala** in the Arabian Sea.
 
• The island group consists of **36 islands**, but only **10 islands are inhabited**. The capital of Lakshadweep is **Kavaratti.**
 
• **Famous Islands:** Some of the well-known islands include **Agatti, Minicoy, Bangaram, and Kalpeni**. They are renowned for their **coral reefs** and **marine biodiversity.**
 
• **Tourism:** Lakshadweep is a popular tourist destination, especially for its **water sports, diving, and snorkeling activities.**
 
 
 
• **Andaman and Nicobar Islands:**
 
 
• **Location:** These islands are located in the **Bay of Bengal** and consist of two major groups: the Andaman Islands and the Nicobar Islands.
 
• **Kamorta and Chowra Islands:** Kamorta Island and Chowra Island are part of the Nicobar group of islands and are not related to the Lakshadweep group.
 
• The Andaman and Nicobar Islands are known for their tropical forests, rich marine life, and historical significance.
 
 
 
• **Milo Island:**
 
 
• Milo Island is not a recognized or official island in India. It is not part of the Lakshadweep or Andaman and Nicobar groups.
 
• This option might be fictitious or incorrectly mentioned in the question.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Union Territories in India:**

 
 
• India has **8 Union Territories**, including **Lakshadweep, Delhi, Chandigarh, Puducherry, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Dadra and Nagar Haveli, Daman and Diu, and Ladakh.**
 
• The Union Territories are directly governed by the **Central Government**, unlike states which have their own governments.
 
 
 
• **Geographical Significance:**
 
 
• **Lakshadweep Islands:** These islands are known for their **coral reefs and lagoons**, making them ecologically important.
 
• **Andaman and Nicobar Islands:** These islands serve as an important naval base due to their strategic location in the Bay of Bengal.
